title: A computational study to identify Sesamol derivatives as NRF2 activator for protection against drug-induced liver injury (DILI).
authors: Mili, Ajay; Birangal, Sumit; Nandakumar, Krishnadas; Lobo, Richard
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选芝麻酚衍生物作为NRF2激活剂，靶向KEAP1蛋白，属于蛋白-小分子配体互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Drug-induced liver injury can be caused by any drugs, their metabolites, or natural products due to the inefficient functioning of drug-metabolizing enzymes, resulting in reactive oxygen species generation and leading to oxidative stress-induced cell death. For protection against oxidative stress, our cell has various defense mechanisms. One of the mechanisms is NRF2 pathway, when activated, protects the cell against oxidative stress. Natural antioxidants such as Sesamol have reported pharmacological activity (hepatoprotective & cardioprotective) and signaling pathways (NRF2 & CREM) altering potential. A Computational analysis was done using molecular docking, IFD, ADMET, MM-GBSA, and Molecular dynamic simulation of the Schrodinger suite. A total of 63,345 Sesamol derivatives were downloaded for the PubChem database. The protein structure of KEAP1-NRF2 (PDB: 4L7D) was downloaded from the RCSB protein database. The molecular docking technique was used to screen compounds that can form an interaction similar to the co-crystalized ligand (1VX). Based on MM-GBSA, docking score, and interactions, ten compounds were selected for ADMET profiling and IFD. After IFD, five compounds (66867225, 46148111, 12444939, 123892179, & 94817569) were selected for molecular dynamics simulation (MDS). Protein-ligand complex stability was assessed during MDS. The selected compounds (66867225, 46148111, 12444939, 123892179, & 94817569) complex with KEAP1 protein shows good stability and bond retentions. In our study, we observed that the selected compounds show good interaction, PCA, R(g), binding free energy, and ADMET profile. We can conclude that the selected compounds can act as NRF2 activators, which should be validated using proper in-vivo/in-vitro models.
abstract_zh: 药物性肝损伤可由任何药物、其代谢物或天然产物引起，原因是药物代谢酶功能低下，导致活性氧生成，进而引发氧化应激诱导的细胞死亡。为抵御氧化应激，我们的细胞拥有多种防御机制，其中之一是NRF2通路，该通路激活后可保护细胞免受氧化应激损伤。天然抗氧化剂如芝麻酚（Sesamol）已被报道具有药理活性（保肝和保心作用）及改变信号通路（NRF2和CREM）的潜力。本研究采用Schrodinger套件中的分子对接、IFD、ADMET、MM-GBSA和分子动力学模拟进行了计算分析。从PubChem数据库下载了共63,345个芝麻酚衍生物。KEAP1-NRF2蛋白结构（PDB: 4L7D）从RCSB蛋白质数据库获取。利用分子对接技术筛选能与共晶配体（1VX）形成类似相互作用的化合物。基于MM-GBSA、对接得分和相互作用，筛选出十个化合物进行ADMET分析和IFD。经IFD后，五个化合物（66867225、46148111、12444939、123892179和94817569）被选作分子动力学模拟（MDS）。在MDS期间评估了蛋白质-配体复合物的稳定性。所选化合物（66867225、46148111、12444939、123892179和94817569）与KEAP1蛋白的复合物显示出良好的稳定性和键合保持性。在我们的研究中，观察到所选化合物表现出良好的相互作用、PCA、R(g)、结合自由能和ADMET特性。我们可得出结论，所选化合物可作为NRF2激活剂，但需通过适当的体内/体外模型进行验证。
